slides.heading: Affordable Color Printing
slides.body: Each included set of Epson EcoFit® ink bottles is equivalent to about 80 ink cartridges(1).
slides.alt: EcoTank printer with ink bottles showing value comparison

slides.heading: Up to 3 Years of Ink Included in the Box(2)
slides.body: Large ink tanks reduce the hassle of frequently replacing ink cartridges.

slides.heading: Our Most Reliable EcoTank® Ever
slides.body: Unique permanent printhead with pro-grade engineering delivers improved everyday reliability.

slides.heading: Unique Epson PrecisionCore® Print Technology
slides.body: High 4,800 x 1,200 print resolution for sharp text & true photographic print quality.
slides.alt: High quality print samples from EcoTank

slides.heading: Get a New EcoTank Printer Plus Upgrades.
slides.body: Get a free printer upgrade every 2-years. Plus no up-front costs and a 30-day risk-free trial.

slides.heading: Print All You Want Worry-Free
slides.body: With Automatic Ink Replenishment, Epson will ship you replacement ink before you run out.

slides.heading: Zero Page Limits & Overage Fee’s
slides.body: Epson ReadyPrint has zero page limits and overage fee’s. Just a predicatble low monthly cost.
slides.alt: ReadyPrint zero page limits and overage fees

slides.heading: Premium White Glove Customer Support
slides.body: Get continuous printer coverage with dedicated agent support and next business day unit exchange.

images.alt: Printer front view with ink bottles

points.heading: Uniquely Keyed EcoFit® Ink Bottles
points.body: Makes refilling ink simple. No mess, no stress and no ink bottle mix-ups.

points.heading: Wireless Mobile Printing
points.body: Wirelessly print and scan from your PC or smart device(4), including support for Apple® AirPrint®. Enjoy enhanced mobile printing from the Epson Smart Panel® App(5).

points.heading: 1.44" Color Display
points.body: Designed for simple navigation and printer management.

points.heading: Stunning Print Quality
points.body: Powered by Epson PrecisionCore® print technology, EcoTank® produces incredible photographic print quality from a recognized leader in photographic printing.

points.heading: Robust Paper Handling
points.body: 100-sheet paper input tray and auto 2-sided printing.

disclaimers: 1. Individual cartridges estimate based on print yields of an included or replacement set of black and color ink bottles as compared to Epson standard-capacity ink cartridges for similarly featured printers as of March 2024.
2. Based on average monthly document print volumes of about 125 pages.

4. Most features require an Internet connection to the printer, as well as an Internet- and/or email-enabled device. For a list of Epson Connect™ enabled printers and compatible devices and apps, visit epson.com/connect.
5. Requires Epson Smart Panel app download. Data usage fees may apply.
